name: Dr. Mortimer, Blight of the Pits
text:
Instant - {t}: Cure a disease an opponent controls. If you do, create a Silver token.
Attack Reaction - {t}, destroy 2 Silver you control: Target Assassin attack gets go again.

name: Dr. Mortimer
text:
Instant - {t}: Cure a disease an opponent controls. If you do, create a Silver token.
Attack Reaction - {t}, destroy 2 Silver you control: Target Assassin attack gets go again.

name: Phial of Calamity
text:
While this is in your graveyard, at the start of your turn, you may destroy 2 Silver you control. If you do, equip this.
Attack Reaction - {r}, destroy this: Until end of turn, target dagger gets "When this hits a hero, create a Frailty, Inertia, or Bloodrot Pox token under their control."

name: Cadaver Handlers
text:
While this is in your graveyard, at the start of your turn, you may destroy 2 Silver you control. If you do, equip this.
Attack Reaction - Destroy this: Cards defending target Assassin attack get -1{d} this chain link. Activate this only if the defending hero is infected.
Battleworn

name: Demoralize the Dracai
text:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' red cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
Whenever an attack action card you control hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

name: Mutually Assured Destruction
text:
Contract - You are contracted to banish infected opponents' cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
The first time each hero plays a reaction card this chain link, create a Bloodrot Pox token under each hero's control, then banish the top card of each hero's deck.

name: Prey on Insecurity
text:
Stealth
Attack Reaction - Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck, destroy this: Another target attack with stealth gets +3{p}.

name: Remember the Mists
text:
When this hits a hero, look at their hand and banish a card. They may play the banished card until the end of their next turn.
If this wasn't played from hand or arsenal, it gets +2{p}.

name: Tailored Targeting
text:
When this attacks, name a card.
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' cards with the chosen name. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
Whenever you hit an opposing hero this chain link, banish the top card of their deck. If it's the named card, repeat this process.

name: Outbreak
text: Target Assassin attack action card gets +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, create a Frailty, Inertia, and Bloodrot Pox token under their control."

name: Prolonged Illness
text: Until end of turn, whenever a disease token is destroyed, if it's the first disease token with that name that's been destroyed this turn, create a token copy of it under the same hero's control.

name: Seed Bloodrot
text: Create a Bloodrot Pox token under each hero's control.

name: Seed Frailty
text: Create a Frailty token under each hero's control.

name: Seed Inertia
text: Create an Inertia token under each hero's control.
